findings.title: Gemini integration calls retired model gemini-1.5-flash (404 since 2025-09-24)
findings.impact: The flagship AI pair-programming journey (J5) fails for every user with a valid API key: generateContent returns 404 'models/gemini-1.5-flash is not found for API version v1beta'. App surfaces it as 'Gemini Error: ...'.
findings.exploit_or_repro: Set a valid GEMINI_API_KEY in .env, build, ask AI anything -> HTTP 404 from Google endpoint (model shut down Sept 24 2025).
findings.remediation: Switch endpoint model to a supported one (gemini-2.5-flash or gemini-flash-latest); send key via x-goog-api-key header instead of URL query.

findings.title: No Gradle wrapper in repo; documented ./gradlew build command cannot run
evidence: [E:cmd#2 git ls-files (59 files, no gradlew, no gradle/wrapper/*)]
findings.impact: Fresh clone cannot build via documented instructions; build depends on undocumented locally-installed Gradle of exact version (AGP 9.1.1 requires Gradle >= 9.3.1).
findings.exploit_or_repro: git clone && ./gradlew assembleDebug -> 'No such file or directory'.
findings.remediation: Commit gradlew, gradlew.bat, gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.{jar,properties} pinned to Gradle 9.3.1+.

findings.title: debug buildType signs with ${rootDir}/debug.keystore that does not exist and is gitignored
findings.impact: assembleDebug fails on any clean checkout (keystore file missing) unless developer hand-creates it; README does not mention this step.
findings.exploit_or_repro: Clean clone + wrapper fix -> ./gradlew assembleDebug -> keystore not found for signing config 'debugConfig' (INFERENCE from config; unexecuted).
findings.remediation: Remove custom debugConfig signingConfig and use AGP's auto-generated default debug keystore.

findings.title: Newly created files never persist edits: selectFile called with in-memory id=0 entity
evidence: [E:app/src/main/java/com/example/ui/viewmodel/CodeEditorViewModel.kt:createNewFile — repository.insertFile(newFile) discards returned rowId; selectFile(newFile) with newFile.id=0]
findings.impact: J3 data loss: user creates a file, types code, every updateCodeText issues @Update WHERE id=0 -> no row updated. On app restart or file switch the new file is empty. Silent.
findings.exploit_or_repro: Create 'test.js', type code, kill app, reopen -> file content is only the '/* Newly created file */' seed.
findings.remediation: Capture rowId from insertFile and select the entity copy with the real id (or re-query by path).

findings.title: Gemini API key shipped inside APK (BuildConfig) and passed in URL query string
findings.impact: Anyone can unzip the APK / read BuildConfig strings and extract the developer's live API key, then run up billing. URL-embedded keys also leak into proxies/logs.
findings.exploit_or_repro: apktool d app-release.apk; grep BuildConfig -> GEMINI_API_KEY plaintext.
findings.remediation: Minimum: header-based key (x-goog-api-key), document API-key restrictions (package+cert fingerprint) in README. Correct: backend proxy for AI calls.

findings.title: WebView executes untrusted HTML/JS with file access defaults and unrestricted navigation; never destroyed
evidence: [E:app/src/main/java/com/example/ui/components/HtmlPreview.kt:L18-L40 javaScriptEnabled=true, domStorageEnabled=true, plain WebViewClient, no allowFileAccess=false, no DisposableEffect destroy]
findings.impact: AI-generated or pasted HTML runs with file:// access on API 24-29 devices and can navigate the WebView to arbitrary external origins; WebView instance leaks on recomposition/dispose.
findings.exploit_or_repro: Paste <script>location='https://evil.example'</script> or file:/// probe into index.html, enable preview.
findings.remediation: settings.allowFileAccess=false, allowContentAccess=false, shouldOverrideUrlLoading blocks non-baseUrl navigation, destroy WebView in DisposableEffect.

findings.title: No CI/CD: .github/ absent, zero automated build/test verification
findings.impact: Nothing prevents committing a non-compiling tree; no regression signal; release committee has no green/red history.
findings.exploit_or_repro: NONE_FOUND
findings.remediation: Add GitHub Actions workflow: setup JDK 17+, gradle wrapper build + testDebugUnitTest on push/PR.

findings.title: No LICENSE file — repo is all-rights-reserved by default, cannot be shipped as OSS
evidence: [E:cmd#12 ls LICENSE* -> 'No such file or directory']
findings.impact: Public repo without license grants no rights to forkers/users; blocks any distribution decision.
findings.exploit_or_repro: NONE_FOUND
findings.remediation: Owner must choose and add a LICENSE (HUMAN DECISION — cannot be automated).

findings.title: ExampleInstrumentedTest asserts packageName 'com.example' but applicationId is 'com.aistudio.devcodeeditor.vscedt'
findings.impact: androidTest suite is red-by-construction on any device run.
findings.exploit_or_repro: connectedDebugAndroidTest fails on useAppContext.
findings.remediation: Assert BuildConfig.APPLICATION_ID.

findings.title: Real-looking personal email and identity hardcoded across UI and mock data
evidence: [E:AppDatabase.kt: SSH seed username 'ari_eshghi' + mock RSA key string]
findings.impact: PII of a real person baked into every install; shown in terminal prompt and commit log UI.
findings.exploit_or_repro: grep -rn 'ari_eshghi' app/src.
findings.remediation: Replace with neutral placeholder identity (dev@devcode.local / 'devcode').

findings.title: allowBackup=true with stock sample backup rules — app DB (files, SSH entries) eligible for cloud backup
findings.impact: User code and stored SSH profiles copied to Google cloud backup without explicit policy.
findings.exploit_or_repro: NONE_FOUND
findings.remediation: Define include/exclude rules or set allowBackup=false until policy decided.

findings.title: fallbackToDestructiveMigration() will silently wipe all user files on any schema bump
findings.impact: First version upgrade that touches schema destroys the user's entire virtual project — data-loss by design.
findings.exploit_or_repro: Bump version=2 without migration -> DB recreated empty.
findings.remediation: exportSchema=true, add real Migrations; acceptable to keep destructive fallback only pre-1.0 with explicit comment.

findings.title: deleteDirectoryAndChildren uses LIKE dirPath||'%' (prefix collision) and runs outside a transaction
evidence: [E:CodeEditorViewModel.kt deleteFile: deleteFile(file) then deleteDirectoryAndChildren(file.path), two separate calls]
findings.impact: Deleting folder '/project' also deletes '/project-x' rows; partial failure leaves orphans.
findings.exploit_or_repro: Create '/proj' and '/proj2' dirs; delete '/proj' -> both gone.
findings.remediation: LIKE dirPath || '/%' plus exact-path delete, wrapped in @Transaction.

findings.title: Room write + full-document regex re-highlight on every keystroke (no debounce)
evidence: [E:CodeHighlighter.kt multiple Regex.findAll passes over whole document]
findings.impact: Typing lag and DB churn grow linearly with file size; battery/IO waste.
findings.exploit_or_repro: Open a multi-thousand-line file, type rapidly.
findings.remediation: Debounce persistence (~400ms) and highlight off the keystroke hot path.

findings.title: Editor TextFieldValue rebuilt via remember(codeText) without preserving selection — cursor reset behavior
evidence: [E:CodeEditorScreen.kt CodeWorkspaceTextEditor: remember(codeText){ TextFieldValue(annotatedString = highlighted) } — selection/composition not carried over]
findings.impact: Cursor jumps (likely to position 0) while typing because each VM round-trip re-keys the state. Grade D: cannot execute in sandbox.
findings.exploit_or_repro: UNTESTABLE locally; requires device/emulator.
findings.remediation: Track TextFieldValue in rememberUpdateState/remember{mutableStateOf} and preserve selection across highlight updates.

findings.title: No logging/crash-reporting infrastructure; errors swallowed or printStackTrace'd
evidence: [E:cmd grep: no Timber/logcat wrapper, no Sentry/Firebase Crashlytics dependency active]
findings.impact: Field failures (AI errors, DB errors) are invisible to maintainers.
findings.exploit_or_repro: NONE_FOUND
findings.remediation: Introduce android.util.Log wrapper with tags now; crash reporting before public release.

findings.title: God files: CodeEditorScreen.kt 1688 LOC, CodeEditorViewModel.kt 948 LOC; no DI; VM owns ~30 state flows
findings.impact: Every feature touches the same two files; high regression risk; untestable without whole VM+Application.
findings.exploit_or_repro: NONE_FOUND
findings.remediation: Split panels into files, extract state holders, introduce simple factory/DI for VM.

findings.title: Zero tests exercise product logic (VM, repository, highlighter, terminal, search/replace)
evidence: [E:cmd#6 all four test files read: 2+2 assertion, string resource, screenshot capture, wrong-package instrumented test]
findings.impact: No regression safety net for any of J1-J7.
findings.exploit_or_repro: NONE_FOUND
findings.remediation: Add Robolectric VM tests for seed/select (J1), persist-on-edit (J2), create-file persistence (J3), replace-all (J6), terminal (J7).

findings.title: Release path undocumented and non-reproducible: env-var signing with missing default keystore, minify off
findings.impact: No one outside the original author can produce a release build; no shrink/obfuscation for a shipping APK.
findings.exploit_or_repro: KEYSTORE_PATH unset -> assembleRelease fails on missing my-upload-key.jks.
findings.remediation: Document release signing env vars in README; add keystore setup steps; evaluate minify.

findings.title: No privacy policy despite sending user code to Google Gemini and claiming secure cloud sync
evidence: [E:CodeEditorViewModel.kt askGeminiPairProgrammer embeds full active-file content in prompt]
findings.impact: Store listing rejection risk; GDPR/CCPA exposure if released publicly.
findings.exploit_or_repro: NONE_FOUND
findings.remediation: Publish privacy policy + in-app disclosure that code is sent to Google. HUMAN: legal text approval.

findings.title: Unbounded in-memory growth: terminalLogs and aiDialogue lists never trimmed
findings.impact: Long sessions grow memory linearly; LazyColumn recomposition cost.
findings.exploit_or_repro: Loop 10k terminal commands.
findings.remediation: Cap lists (e.g. last 500 entries).

findings.title: Duplicate testTag 'submit_button' on AI-quick-fix IconButton and the editor BasicTextField
findings.impact: UI tests targeting the tag are ambiguous/flaky.
findings.exploit_or_repro: onNodeWithTag('submit_button') throws AmbiguousMatchError when both visible.
findings.remediation: Rename tags uniquely (ai_quick_fix_button, code_editor_input).

findings.title: Simulated features presented as real: fake SSH success, fake cloud sync, fake git; metadata claims 'production-ready'
evidence: [E:CodeEditorViewModel.kt executeTerminalCommand ssh connect prints 'Success... 256-bit AES' with no socket code]
findings.impact: User trust / potential store-policy misrepresentation if shipped as-is.
findings.exploit_or_repro: Run 'ssh connect anything' -> instant fake success.
findings.remediation: Label panels DEMO/SIMULATED in UI and align metadata.json with README's concept framing.

findings.title: Audit sandbox cannot execute Android builds (no JDK/SDK, Maven+Google hosts unreachable) — execution deferred to CI
findings.impact: All pre-remediation EXEC-lane conclusions are Grade B/C/D; Grade A obtainable only via GitHub Actions.
findings.exploit_or_repro: NONE_FOUND
findings.remediation: Use CI as execution venue (done in Phase 7).
